spans.s: A particle of affirmation, even, just, only; यथा वशन्ति देवास्तथेदसद्

especially in strengthening a statement; अर्थज्ञ इत्सकलं
 भद्रमश्नुते Nir.
It is often added to words expressing excess or exclusion: विश्व इत् एक इत् &c.

At the beginning of sentences it often adds emphasis to pronouns, prepositions
 &c. (its place is taken by एव in classical Sanskrit).
